{{Quote|No blasters!! No blasters!!|The bartender|<ref name="Politics" />}}
By some point between [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]] and [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{ThePoliticsOfContrabandDate|Easy Money}}</ref> a '''Twi'lek''' worked as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] at the rough, [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]-frequented [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] [[Event Horizon (Seikosha)|Event Horizon]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Cairn (city)|Cairn]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Seikosha/Legends|Seikosha]]<ref name="Politics" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Nembus sector/Legends|Nembus sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Breago system/Legends|Breago system]]</ref>

{{RPG|"[[Easy Money]]"}}
At one point, while the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] was tending bar, alternating between serving [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverages]] and scrubbing at a [[Blood/Legends|bloodstain]] on the bartop, a group of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] entered the establishment. They soon met [[Chiron Drebbick]], an [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] who was posing as an [[Aide/Legends|aide]] to the local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Lydenn Carridon]] and who intended to intercept a shipment that the smugglers had brought to Seikosha on behalf of the crime [[Lord/Legends|lord]] [[Janelle Serap]]. After Drebbick ordered a group of [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] enforcers to beat the smugglers up, every patron of the Event Horizon drew their [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] in anticipation of the bar fight. Meanwhile, the bartender, yelling for everyone to refrain from using [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], sought cover for himself.<ref name="Politics" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Twi'lek bartender appeared in "[[Easy Money]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Eric S. Trautmann]] and published in the [[1992]] [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[The Politics of Contraband]]''. In the adventure, the scene featuring the bartender appears if the player characters manage to land their [[Starship/Legends|starship]] in Cairn before being forced to travel through Seikosha's [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]. This article assumes that as many of the events presented in "Easy Money" as possible happened and therefore also assumes that is indeed the order those events unfolded in.<ref name="Politics" />
